title: Employee Voice and Silence

title: Precision of the Anchor Influences the Amount of Adjustment
book_use: Across five studies people adjusted less from precise numerical anchors than from rounded anchors; Chapter: 5; Caveat: Experimental estimation tasks; do not assume every precise business forecast will anchor every audience in the same way

title: The Too-Much-Precision Effect
book_use: Greater numerical precision can strengthen anchoring for amateurs but excessive precision can backfire with experts who infer lower competence; Chapter: 5; Caveat: Negotiation experiments rather than startup decks; this qualifies any simple claim that more precision is always more persuasive
